rv.q: He has transformed it into an exhilarating piece of theatre—funny, moving, educational, and performed with a virtuosity that never once calls attention to itself.
Montano is an ingratiating and thoroughly engaging storyteller.

Robert Montano seriously went after the latter, and I am intensely grateful to him for allaying my fear that I chose the wrong path. His solo show, Small, is an eye-opening look at the way jockeys sacrifice their physical and mental health to win the race—and more broadly how an obsession with a prestige career can nearly derail a life.
Montano deserves credit for his messy-but-real coming-of-age tale
Small lifts you into the saddle and challenges you to hang on for a bumpy but exhilarating ride.

cn.t: Robert Montano delivers a tour-de-force performance in this polished autobiographical solo show about his teenage dream of becoming a jockey, racing through a compelling coming-of-age story with confident swagger and theatrical flair.
